part: SQUATCHEE-SPIN propeller v2.1 (PLA) - 2-blade D100 vintage paddle planform, 20-deg wedge pitch, prints flat, D7.2 bore for the retainer sleeve
notes: v2.1 pivot rework (field fix): bore D5.0 -> D7.2 so the retainer v2 sleeve (OD 6.6) drops INSIDE the bore and the prop spins on the sleeve's smooth continuous cylinder instead of the slotted mast spindle - same 0.30-0.90 mm worst-case diametral clearance contract as v1 (7.2/6.6 vs 5.0/4.4 at +-0.15), binding impossible; retention moves from the sleeve rim to the D9.5 retainer head flange (1.15 mm overlap per side). Bore change is axisymmetric -> balance untouched. Hub D14 keeps a 3.4 mm wall; blade roots start at x=5 > bore r3.6. NOT interchangeable with v1 mount/retainer - v2 parts are a matched set. Paddle outline (47-pt CCW polygon, min segment 1.5 mm - denser sub-mm tip chords left sliver facets -> geometric_ok false): Hermite neck (half-width 3.8 at x=5, waist 3.59 at x~12, slope-matched at x=20) into ellipse (center x=32.5, a=17.5, b=7 -> widest 14 mm chord at 65% span, elliptical tip). Wedge pitch: top shaved by plane z = y*tan20 + 3.248 (0.70 mm trailing edge at widest point, 5.80 mm max leading edge < hub 6). Bed side dead flat. Exact y-mirror + 180-deg blade symmetry -> CG on axis. BOOLEAN ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: bore cut on the VIRGIN hub cylinder first, blades fused b1+b2, hub merged LAST as union(a=blades, b=hubB) - other orders leave sliver facets on the fused coplanar bottom face (geometric_ok false).
